summary: Iteration 161 - Data Integrity, Alert Rules, LLM Budget Banner, Drift Alert Watcher. All 4 backlog items verified: (1) LLM budget banner code path verified in ai_service.py, routes/ai.py, useChat.js, ChatMessages.jsx - HTTP 402 with error_code='llm_budget_exceeded' renders amber pill with 'Top up Universal Key' link, (2) Data Integrity Panel renders correctly with stat grid (unknown_tokens, backfills, le_repairs, toxic_lessons, brute_force) and 14-day sparklines, (3) Alert Rules Editor CRUD fully functional - create/list/evaluate/delete all working, (4) Backend APIs all passing - 19/19 pytest tests green.

issues: React key warning: 'Encountered two children with the same key' for bid-0, bid-1.19, ask-1.38 etc - likely in order book or price display component

action_items: Fix React key warnings in order book/price display component (non-critical, cosmetic)
critical_code_review_comments: LLM budget banner implementation is clean - HTTP 402 → structured payload → useChat.js maps to error_code → ChatMessages.jsx renders amber pill
Data Integrity Panel correctly fetches /api/admin/data-integrity/summary and /timeseries?days=14
Alert Rules Editor has proper validation - invalid metric returns 400 with supported metrics list, malformed channel returns 400

context_for_next_testing_agent: Data Integrity Panel and Alert Rules Editor are in Admin Panel → Tools tab (last tab in Insights group). LLM budget banner cannot be tested by actually exhausting budget - verify code path only. All 4 backlog items from this iteration are complete and verified.

llm_budget_banner.details: Code path verified: ai_service.py detects 'Budget has been exceeded' → returns {error: 'llm_budget_exceeded'} → routes/ai.py maps to HTTP 402 with structured payload → useChat.js handles 402 and creates message with error_code → ChatMessages.jsx renders amber pill with data-testid='message-budget-*' and 'budget-topup-link-*'

data_integrity_panel.details: Panel renders with stat grid showing: UNKNOWN TOKENS 24H/7D, GRADE BACKFILLS 7D, LE REPAIRS 7D, TOXIC LESSONS 7D, SUPERSEDED TOTAL, LOCKOUTS 24H/7D. Sparklines visible under stats. 'All invariants passing' badge and 'Run audit now' button present.

alert_rules_editor.details: Full CRUD tested: Create rule (TEST_ui_rule_playwright) → appears in rules-list → Evaluate now (shows 'Evaluated 1 rules · fired 0 · throttled 0') → Delete rule → rule removed from list. Form elements: rule_id, metric dropdown, comparator, threshold, window_hours, throttle_hours, channel, enabled checkbox, Save rule button, Evaluate now button.

drift_alert_watcher_slack.details: Unit test confirms _dispatch_slack returns None when SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL is unset. Skips non-allowlisted alert types.

backend_apis.details: GET /api/admin/data-integrity/summary returns expected shape with unknown_direction_tokens, backfills, toxic_lessons, brute_force. GET /api/admin/data-integrity/timeseries?days=14 returns 14 days of bucket data. Alert rules CRUD: GET/POST/DELETE /api/admin/data-integrity/alert-rules, POST /evaluate-now, GET /alert-events all working. Invalid metric returns 400, malformed channel returns 400.
